_meta.description: GOJ Template Registry — REX reads this to know which template to use for any request
_meta.verification_method: pdfplumber text/table extraction + Claude Vision readability analysis

weekly_menu_form.description: Weekly meal selection form filled out by each client. One form per client (2 pages). Client checks off desired food items for each day of the week (Mon–Fri). Covers salads, soups, main courses, and sides.
when_to_use: Client needs to submit their weekly food order
Kato asks for the menu form or client meal form
Staff needs blank forms to distribute to clients at the facility
weekly_menu_form.submission_flow: Client fills out → Allen scans → emails to atigerclawai@gmail.com → processed into system
weekly_menu_form.timing: Submitted ONE WEEK in advance. This week's orders were emailed ~7-10 days ago.

signin_sheet.description: Daily attendance sign-in sheet for GOJ clients. Columns: No, Name, Insurance Plan, CH, TR, Signature. Blue rows = CPHL clients.
when_to_use: Staff needs today's or tomorrow's attendance sheet
signin_sheet.note: Use generate_tomorrow.py for a pre-populated version with client names sorted by last name. Use this blank template only if generation fails.

machine_readability.notes: Clean table structure with clear headers. All text is OCR-friendly. Single table spans across 2 pages.

distribution_sheet.description: Food distribution handoff sheet for kitchen/serving staff. Columns: No, Client Name, Salad, Soup, Main + Side, V (vegetarian flag). Used at mealtime to distribute correct meals to each client.
when_to_use: Kitchen staff needs to know what each client ordered
Kato asks for distribution sheet or food handoff
Sent daily at 10am for the following day
distribution_sheet.note: Use generate_tomorrow.py for a pre-populated version pulling from client menu orders. This blank is a fallback.

machine_readability.notes: Well-formed table with clear column headers and checkmark symbol. Excellent for OCR and data extraction. Spans 2 pages.

driver_sheet.description: Driver route and pickup sheet for GOJ transportation. Lists clients by route, with addresses and pickup order.
when_to_use: Driver needs their route for the day
Kato needs to check transportation assignments

machine_readability.notes: Clear table structure with 5 columns. Address and phone fields are spacious for data entry. Single-page format is ideal for scanning.

kitchen_sheet.description: Kitchen preparation sheet showing total quantities of each menu item needed for the day. Used by kitchen staff to know how much of each dish to prepare.
when_to_use: Kitchen needs to know quantities to cook
Kato asks for kitchen sheet or prep sheet
Sent daily at 10am for the following day

machine_readability.notes: Dual-table layout (SALADS section + other items). Clear structure with section headers. Spans 2 pages. Checkbox symbols are standard and OCR-friendly.

modes.all: Generates sign-in + distribution + driver + kitchen sheets

flags.--send: Send generated PDFs via Telegram (Rexxie) after generating
flags.--shift N: Generate only for shift 1 or shift 2

schedule.10am_daily: Kitchen + distribution + sign-in sheets for NEXT day generated and sent via Rexxie
schedule.7_30am_daily: Morning report: today's expected clients + menu status

menu_ordering_workflow.step_1: Clients fill out GOJ_Weekly_Menu_Form.pdf at the facility
menu_ordering_workflow.step_2: Allen scans completed forms and emails to atigerclawai@gmail.com
menu_ordering_workflow.step_3: REX checks Gmail for new scans (look back 6-14 days since menus submitted 1 week early)
menu_ordering_workflow.step_4: Scanned PDFs OCR'd and menu selections stored in auth_tracker.db (dietary_notes per client)
menu_ordering_workflow.step_5: generate_tomorrow.py uses dietary_notes to build distribution + kitchen sheets
menu_ordering_workflow.timing_note: Menus for THIS week were submitted LAST week. Always look back 7-10 days in Gmail.

machine_readability_verification.summary: All 4 operational templates are clean, well-structured PDFs with clear table layouts. All are OCR-friendly and suitable for automated form generation and data extraction workflows. No visual degradation or layout issues detected.

all_templates: All templates are suitable for automated form population with generate_tomorrow.py
All templates pass OCR readability checks and can be scanned reliably
Maintain current blank templates as fallback sources in dashboard/templates/
Use verified paths for programmatic template access in REX systems
